summary_md:
# 117: Hundyoga, miljardärer och AI-skulden

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-08-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN's Börssurr episode 117 ranges over rising 30-year government bond yields (driven partly by huge AI/big-tech credit issuance crowding out sovereign debt), sticky inflation and inflation expectations, and a Bank of America survey showing low cash and heavy bullish positioning that leaves surprise risk to the downside. The hosts favour conservative 'eternity portfolio' quality compounders (Latour, Investor, banks, Atlas Copco, Volvo) over speculative AI names, while flagging speculative trade ideas in Scandic, Klarna and a possible AstraZeneca/BMS deal. Overall constructive on earnings and an emerging industrial recovery but wary of stretched positioning and bank-tax/political risk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 LATO-B — Latour | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Quality compounder now trading at a discount after several weak years; industrial arm signals a cyclical turn; host owns long-term.

#### Reasoning

Host is openly biased, has owned Latour 15-20 years and intends to hold 15-20 more. Frames it as 'oxfilé not korv' quality that, unlike Industrivärden's premium, now trades at a discount after underperforming, making it attractive. Latour and Idun reports point to an industrial recovery. A long-term hold rather than a timing trade; near-term drawdowns acknowledged.

#### Sell Triggers

- if quality/compounding track record deteriorates
- if industrial recovery stalls
- if discount to NAV disappears or turns to premium

> *"det är ju ett sådant kvalitetsbolag som man tryggt kan äga... nu handlas de ju med rabatt"*

---

### 🟢 SHOT — Scandic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

A skilled investor friend is very bullish: sound finances, good occupancy, good management, plus southern-European tourists flocking to a cooler Nordics.

#### Reasoning

Presented as a friend's high-conviction bull case: finances in order, strong occupancy, positive momentum, a competent Danish CEO. Structural tailwind from climate-driven tourism shifting toward the Nordics, plus healthy Swedish economy and business travel. Hosts endorse the thesis and note Pandox correlation. Conviction is second-hand, so moderate.

#### Sell Triggers

- if occupancy weakens
- if Nordic tourism inflows fail to materialize
- if management/strategy changes
- if economy deteriorates

> *"Han är väldigt bullish på Scandic... Finanserna i ordning, bra beläggning, det händer grejer, bra ledning."*

---

### 🟠 PNDX-B — Pandox | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Owns many hotels including northern Norway; correlated with Scandic, so a like-Scandic-like-Pandox read on Nordic hotel/tourism strength.

#### Reasoning

Mentioned as a correlated way to play the same Nordic hotel/tourism thesis as Scandic. No dedicated fundamental case beyond correlation, so a watch rather than a conviction buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nordic hotel demand weakens
- if Scandic thesis breaks down

> *"Alltså gillar man Scandic borde man kunna gilla Pandox också, det finns en viss korrelation."*

---

### 🟢 AZN — AstraZeneca | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stock has fallen and looks cheap; speculative idea to buy if a rumored BMS acquisition happens and cost cuts later prove accretive; strong pipeline.

#### Reasoning

Highly speculative. Shares dropped on FT rumor of a Bristol Myers bid the market dislikes; hosts argue that if the deal happens and the stock falls further, aggressive post-merger cost cutting ('a Gardell trade') could make it a good acquisition, so buy the dip. Separately it's simply seen as too cheap with a deep pipeline. CEO Soriot deal/departure risk cuts both ways.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the BMS deal proves value-destructive or integration falters
- if CEO Pascal Soriot departs
- if pipeline disappoints

> *"Men Astra är intressant ändå för den har kommit ner så mycket... då ska vi köpa den. För då kommer man senare skörda frukterna"*

---

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

CEO Torsten Jansson interviewed amid signs of a cyclical upturn; hosts flag it as a relevant name to watch how the stock trades.

#### Reasoning

Raised in the context of an emerging industrial/consumer cyclical recovery with strong order intake and earnings across companies. Hosts explicitly say it's a relevant question how the stock trades but stop short of a directional call, so a watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the cyclical recovery reverses
- if order intake weakens

> *"Vad sa Torsten Jansson i New Wave?... Vi ska se hur aktien går, en bra fråga."*

---

### 🟢 KLAR — Klarna | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down 20% on report, CFO leaving, weak Germany, poor since IPO, bad US credits — but a tempting contrarian bank-challenger angle.

#### Reasoning

A deliberately provocative, low-conviction contrarian trade: one host pitches 'Köp Klarna' precisely because it has done so badly (post-IPO slump, CFO exit, German weakness, dubious US credits) yet has structural upside as a card/bank challenger. The co-host refuses to own it and both flag large risks and moral qualms about consumer lending, so weak/speculative at best.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US credit losses rise
- if German business keeps deteriorating
- if bank-challenger growth fails to materialize
- if further management departures

> *"Jag har en trade till dig på det. Köp Klarna... Jag skulle aldrig våga ta den risken."*
